hero.name: Aster
hero.ambition: Protect the place I call home

world.name: The Morrow Reach

locations.name: Mossbell
locations.description: A small settlement of hearth fires, kitchen gardens, and familiar faces. Ashfall fever has reached its households; the old shrine is still a place to seek help. Ancestral rites require a witness or academy license; raising bodies and binding unwilling souls are prohibited. Households reached safety before the rupture destroyed their homes.

locations.name: Goldmere
locations.description: The region’s busy city gathers an academy, a guild market, and a sworn order behind its stone walls. Fever wards are filling, and scholars disagree over the cause. Public necromantic practice is prohibited. Authorities require a witness or evidence before opening an investigation. The city survived with damaged wards and an urgent need for ordinary repairs.

locations.name: Reedcross
locations.description: A riverside village where millers, ferrymen, and herbalists trade news. Families are sheltering travelers fleeing Ashfall fever. Ancestral rites require a witness or academy license; raising bodies and binding unwilling souls are prohibited. The households reached the refugee camp before the surge. Buildings and the old mill were lost.

locations.name: The Copperwood
locations.description: Old trails connect both villages beneath a canopy of moss and copper leaves. Healing herbs grow here, alongside hungry beasts and abandoned camps. The nearest settlement’s law governs witnessed acts.

locations.name: Saint Orin’s Ruin
locations.description: An abandoned sanctuary beyond the forest holds sealed research and the memories of its former keepers. Licensed expeditions may study its ancestral records; disturbing remains without consent invites scrutiny.

locations.name: The Stormward Peaks
locations.description: Wind-carved passes and abandoned mines cross the northern mountains. Guides keep a refuge beneath the high stones.

locations.name: The Reedwaste
locations.description: Lanterns mark a boardwalk through deep reed beds. Apothecaries gather rare remedies beside drowned foundations.

locations.name: Saltbell Harbor
locations.description: A harbor of salt-white sails, fisher families, and traders from distant provinces. New arrivals bring both opportunity and rumor.

locations.name: The Moonward Spire
locations.description: A lonely observatory studies the stars and preserves knowledge beyond the city academy’s reach. Its keepers welcome careful learners.

locations.name: The Wandering Hearth
locations.description: Travelers, scouts, and craftspeople share a guarded camp. A meal and an honest story can earn a place by the communal fire. Shared kitchens, a meeting hearth, and timber dwellings turn temporary shelter into a permanent community.

locations.name: The Dawn Gate
locations.description: An ancient gateway controls the road into the uplands. Watchers record travelers, while weathered carvings hint at older promises.

locations.name: The Bastion of Bells
locations.description: A fortified settlement overlooks the eastern roads. Orders and guilds offer an alternative to the city’s institutions. The covenant mechanism and its citadel were permanently destroyed. The voices it held are free.

locations.name: The Hearthward Sanctuary
locations.description: A protected sanctuary shelters displaced families and teachers. Its doors remain open when other institutions fall silent.

world.laws: Local councils set their own rules. In Goldmere, necromancy is forbidden; in Mossbell, it is regulated; in Reedcross, it is regulated. Authorities act on witnesses, reports, and discovered evidence. Willing ancestral contact, grave theft, and unwilling soul binding are treated as different acts.
world.culture: Families honor willing ancestors with named memorials; a person’s consent matters beyond death.

festival.name: The Hearthlight Gathering
festival.tradition: Families share a public meal and leave a place for absent friends.

rumors: The academy in Goldmere is seeking careful field observers, not only wealthy students.
A moonwise ranger near The Copperwood can teach a refuge ritual without demanding allegiance.
Discreet physicians preserve ancestral knowledge despite the ban.

mentors.name: Ser Rowan Bell
mentors.description: A sworn protector offers training and an initiation founded on a visible oath of mercy and protection.

mentors.name: Physician Sable
mentors.description: A physician quietly teaches consensual ancestral rites and points promising students toward the ruined archive.

mentors.name: The Grey Finch
mentors.description: A discreet contact offers a test of stealth and judgment, with the terms disclosed before accepting.

You respected my sibling’s fear while recovering the transport evidence.

ending.title: The Broken Anchor
ending.summary: The mechanism is destroyed. Its captive voices are free, but the landscape and settlements bear a permanent wound. Survivors decide what can be rebuilt. Lasting losses or departures: Mossbell, Reedcross, The Bastion of Bells.
